description: Use when an agent needs to know whether a Solana token's holders are one owner. Returns the account that first funded each of the top 20 wallets, the clusters sharing a funder and their supply share. A shared funder can be an exchange. Costs 0.008 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).
